acceptance: Test or scripted check: with a benchbox.egg-info/SOURCES.txt that lists a file excluded by MANIFEST.in, make test-package's sdist does not contain that file.
make test-package still passes on a clean checkout.
description:
## Problem
setuptools reuses benchbox.egg-info/SOURCES.txt from an earlier build in the same checkout. On 2026-11-24 a worktree built before the TPC-DI appendix exclusion produced an sdist that still contained _sources/tpc-di/*.sql, so a test of the exclusion failed locally until the ignored benchbox.egg-info and build/ directories were deleted. CI builds from clean checkouts and is not affected, and package-smoke now runs scripts/verify_distribution_binaries.py, but local `make test-package` and any local release build can produce or verify a different sdist from the one CI builds.

## Change
Make the local build targets (make test-package and any other target that runs uv build) build from a clean metadata state, for example by removing benchbox.egg-info and build/ inside the checkout first, or by building from a clean export.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create), never the primary clone; heavy test runs only through lock-taking entry points; never set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK or force admission; stage explicit paths; add a changelog.d fragment if users can see the change; no explanatory comments (make comment-policy-check). Delete only those generated directories inside the current checkout; do not change CI build steps.
